purpose: Contract-target development on previously inspected historical dates; no model selection or profitability claim
labels: Official final regular-season boxscore battingOrder and participation counts; unknowns excluded with reasons
model: Fixed regularized multinomial logistic; median imputation and scaling fit only within training folds
folds: 28 initial dates; successive 14-date blocks; no hyperparameter tuning; all previously inspected dates remain development
baseline: Training-only three-class frequencies on identical rows; no historical market prices fabricated
forbidden_features: actual starting pitcher and derived matchup features
nonbinary: Output probability and expected payout bounds; no invented last-fair-market-price estimate
outputs: Explicit research directory only; no production artifact promotion or paper-policy replacement
